queries.name: current_decisions
queries.meaning: active, non-superseded Claim(role=decision), optionally limited to one domain

queries.name: trace_decision
queries.meaning: the Decision, transitive depends_on closure, and Facts with result_of to that Decision

queries.name: impact_by_fact
queries.meaning: Decision Claims transitively dependent on the Fact

queries.name: missing_outcomes
queries.meaning: current Decisions whose expected outcome classes are not all observed by result_of Facts

queries.name: unresolved_conflicts
queries.meaning: contradicting pairs where both records remain current

queries.name: research_gaps
queries.meaning: required dependencies not linked and linked records explicitly stale

queries.name: decision_timeline
queries.meaning: all records in the Decision family across supersession history

queries.name: full_history_aggregate
queries.meaning: all-record totals by type/domain plus Decision and outcome-closed Decision counts
